```{r}
mats <- c(1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 60, 84, 120, 240, 360)
init_date <- "2000-01-01"
end_date <- "2000-01-30"

## date range selection 
date_seq <- seq.Date(ymd(start_date), ymd(end_date), by = "day")
weekday_seq <- date_seq[weekdays(date_seq) %in% c("Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday")]

dr_daily <- function(yield_data, reference=NULL, tkey="time", threshold = 2){

  if (!is.null(reference)) {
    ref_match <- match(reference, as.Date(yield_data[[tkey]]))
    augmented <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(reference), ncol = ncol(yield_data))
    augmented[!is.na(ref_match), ] <- as.matrix(yield_data[ref_match[!is.na(ref_match)], ])
    augmented <- data.frame(augmented)
    colnames(augmented) <- colnames(yield_data)
    augmented[[tkey]] <- reference
  } else {
    augmented <- yield_data
  }

  num_cols <- setdiff(colnames(augmented), tkey)
  augmented[num_cols] <- lapply(augmented[num_cols], as.numeric)

  yield_matrix <- as.matrix(augmented[num_cols])
  nr <- nrow(yield_matrix)
  nc <- ncol(yield_matrix)

  sparse_yields <- rowSums(!is.na(yield_matrix)) < (threshold + 1)
  preceding  <- rbind(matrix(NA, 1, nc), yield_matrix[-nr, ])
  succeeding <- rbind(yield_matrix[-1, ], matrix(NA, 1, nc))

  int_mask <- sparse_yields & is.na(yield_matrix) & 
              !is.na(preceding) & !is.na(succeeding)

  for (col_id in seq_len(nc)) {
    row_mask <- int_mask[, col_id]
    if (any(row_mask)) {
      yprev <- preceding[row_mask,  col_id]
      ynext <- succeeding[row_mask, col_id]
      yield_matrix[row_mask, col_id] <- (yprev + ynext) / 2
    }
  }

  augmented[num_cols] <- yield_matrix

  return(augmented)
}

asdf <- dr_daily(yield_data=tmp, reference=weekday_seq, threshold = 8)
asdf
```

```{r} 
## match dates to reference dates 
date_match2 <- function(target, reference){
  target_full <- target
  target_missing <- rownames(reference)[(!rownames(reference) %in% rownames(target))]
  target_full[target_missing, ] <- NA
  target_full <- target_full[order(as.Date(rownames(target_full))), ]
  target_full
}

## interpolation for missing daily values 
date_interpolate2 <- function(target, reference, int_func = c("spline", "approx")){
  if (int_func == "spline") {
    int_func <- na.spline
  } 
  else if (int_func == "approx") {
    int_func <- na.approx
  }
  else{
    stop("Invalid daily interpolation function: please use spline or approx.")
  } 
  
  target_match <- date_match2(target, reference)
  target_int <- as.data.frame(int_func(target_match[, -1]))
  target_int <- cbind(target_match[, 1], target_int)
  return(target_int) 
  colnames(target_int) <- colnames(target_match) 
  rownames(target_int) <- rownames(reference)
  target_int
}

dr_build_seq <- function(yield_data, 
                         yield_days = c("Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday"), 
                         inc = 0) {
  tsd <- dim(yield_data)
  start_date <- yield_data$time[tsd[1]]; end_date <- yield_data$time[tsd[2]]
  weekday_seq <- date_seq[weekdays(date_seq) %in% yield_days]
  weekday_df <- data.frame(weekday_seq)
  rownames(weekday_df) <- weekday_seq
  return(weekday_df) 
}

asdf <- date_interpolate2(tmp, weekday_df, "spline")
storage.mode(asdf[,-1]) <- "numeric"
asdf[, -1]
```
